Dhavala(sāndhivigrahin)
ins. poet. wrote the Narasapatam Plates of Vajrahasta

A. D.
Epi. Ind. XI. p. 147-53.

Dhavala
authority on dh. Q. by Allāḍanātha in Nirṇayāmṛta,
; by Jīmūtavāhana in Kālaviveka (7 times); by Raghunandana in Tithitattva (Serampore edn.

).
See JASB. XI (1915) 315. 367.
Earlier than 1050 A. D. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 705b.
C.. Dhavalanibandha an. ºsmṛti below.

Dhavala
Jain. son of Sūra, a Brahmin; pupil of Ambasena Ṛṣi.
--Harivam3śapurāṇa in Apabhram3śa. in 122 sandhis.

.
Mentioned by Puṣpadanta in his Mahāpurāṇa (965 A. D.). See Allahabad Uni. Studies I. (1925) 165. See also Jaina Sid. Bhās. XX. ii. p. 25. fn. 3. [Page283-a.

Dhavalacandra
teacher of Gajasāra (a. of Caturvim3śatidaṇḍaka or Ṣaṭtrim3śikāvicāra,

Dhavalacandra
patron of Nārāyaṇa (a. of Hitopadeśa).

Dhavaladhṛtasmṛti
Q. by Bhavadeva Nyāyālaṅkāra in Smṛticandra,

Dhavalanibandha
ref. to by Kāśīnātha in his Caṇḍikārcanadīpikā, RASB. VIII.

(Antyeṣṭiº) an. Kamalākara in Nirṇayasindhu.
C.. Dhavala an. Dhavalasmṛti.

.
See also Mahādhavalapurāṇa, Oudh 1875, 50 an. Vijayadhavalapurāṇa, ibid.

Dhavalasaṅgraha
dh. text from Assam. Q. by Krṣṇamiśra in Kālasarvasva; by Jīmūtavāhana in Kālaviveka; by Gadādhara in Kālasāra; by Viśvanātha in his Smṛtisārasaṅgraha, RASB.

. prob. same a. Dhavalanibandha.
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 570b. J. of Assam Res. Soc.
. p. 93. Orissa His.. Res. J. VI. i. p. 63.

Dhavalasmṛti
Rice 204.
Q. by Raghunandana in Tithitattva.
See also Dhavala above.
